corrections.reason: The initial character is ዕ (ዕንቍ, 'pearl/gem'), misread as ፅ due to a faint ink speck.
The printed word is አዎን ('yes'), where the first-order አ was misread as እ due to a stray mark below it.
The printed glyph is first-order ተ (ተኩል, 'and a half', matching the subsequent occurrences on lines 6 and 9), misread as ት.
In Classical Ge'ez grammar and on the printed page, the feminine plural pronoun is እማንቱኒ ('they [f.] also'), with 6th-order እ.
The line ends with ማ (followed by a hyphenation stroke), wrapping onto line 6 as ለት to form ማለት. Stage 1 hallucinated an extra ለ at the end of line 5.
The printed glyph is ዲ (እንዲርበን ፡ ይርበዋል, parallel to እንዲጠማን ፡ ይጠማዋል on L07), misread as ዳ.
The printed word is በረከተ ፡ ነፍስን ('spiritual blessing / blessing of the soul') with 6th-order ስ, misread as ሱ.
The printed word is ነፍስን with 6th-order ስ, misread as ሱ.
